title: A change can be made to every version of a component at once
goal: Each version of a component is its own drawing, so a change meant for all of them (a new corner radius, a renamed label) has to be made in each one by hand. There should be a way to make one edit reach every version.
notes: The cost was accepted with the decision on 2026-09-05 (each version is a complete drawing). This is the sanded-down version of that cost. Versions live as sibling mains sharing a componentID; ComponentVersions.swift holds the model.
acceptance: An edit made once can be applied to every version of the same component in one undo step
It is clear before it runs which versions it would change
A component with one version is unaffected
